theory.heading: What Data Drift Detection is
theory.body: Data Drift Detection describes the methods and patterns used within AI Engineering to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why Data Drift Detection matters
theory.body: Without Data Drift Detection, systems built with AI Engineering are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Data Drift Detection works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Data Drift Detection follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Data Drift Detection
theory.body: Data Drift Detection offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
